patterns.note: Sections are often composed of a full-bleed background (solid color, abstract pattern, or video) with content layered on top, frequently featuring a strong left-aligned graphic element contrasting with right-aligned text.
Headings use a very large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, lighter-weight body text, all within the same font family.

A core palette of deep blue, white, and light grey is consistently accented by a vibrant, multi-color secondary palette (orange, teal, red, green) used for large geometric shapes and background blocks.
The initial hero features a full-bleed video background of water, which scrolls up to reveal subsequent content. A compact, sticky header appears after the hero section is out of view.

Large, abstract geometric shapes and patterns (e.g., a white maze, colorful L-shaped blocks) are used as primary visual elements within sections, serving as graphic anchors or dividers rather than purely decorative elements.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video background is used in the hero section, with a semi-transparent overlay to ensure text legibility, creating an immersive and dynamic introduction.
A compact, fixed header with branding and navigation is revealed and sticks to the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.

Sections are visually differentiated through full-width background treatments, which include solid colors, abstract patterns, or large, colorful geometric shapes that act as prominent graphic elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with a clean, legible sans-serif body text, maintaining a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — sections are well-separated with ample vertical padding, while content within sections maintains a comfortable density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, abstract geometric shapes and patterns as integral visual elements, often full-bleed or as strong left-aligned anchors, sets it apart. This, combined with a dynamic video hero and a clean, editorial text presentation, creates a unique and bold aesthetic that feels both artistic and professional.
